text: In 1947, the deacon Miguel and three companions are sequestered in a remote monastery for [the last seven days of their training|rules|death on a deadline], when they are believed most vulnerable to demonic influence. The bishop sends [a child healer, Anghela, to stay among them|trigger|an outsider reaches in] with her nun, Sister Cecilia, and the girl [turns stale bread fresh and water into wine|images|food, drink and drugs]. Each deacon is haunted by nightmares of his own sins, while Padre Ricardo investigates [the black liquid that drips from her mouth whenever she heals|threat|the devil and dark gods].
